mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_ai_agent_definition (id, code, agent_version, status, purpose, runtime_ref, workspace_id, created_at, updated_at, retired_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{agentVersion}, #{status}, #{purpose}, #{runtimeRef}, #{workspaceId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{retiredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, agent_version, status, purpose, runtime_ref, workspace_id, created_at, updated_at, retired_at FROM ainer_ai_agent_definition WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, code, agent_version, status, purpose, runtime_ref, workspace_id, created_at, updated_at, retired_at FROM ainer_ai_agent_definition ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
